newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares revving up at open, seen strong.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares revving up at open, seen strong.

text.p: Greek shares staged a strong opening, jumping 1.5 percent to 978.39 points on the benchmark index after the socialist win in national elections on Sunday which had been widely expected by the markets.

"The stock market opened strong, encouraged by the prospect of a stable government with a comfortable majority. Interest rates are dipping in the money market and this is also helping," said a floor trader at a state brokerage.
Greek shares revving up at open, seen strong=2
Trading volume surged to 1.58 billion drachmas after 10 minutes of trade in a broad based advance as gainers outpaced losers 127 to 5.

In the money market depos and forex forwards were moving lower in early active dealing on an expected liquidity injection from forex inflows following the victory of the socialist party, dealers said.

The combination of a strong drachma policy and attractive intrest rate differentials were behind the opening of short ecu long drachma positions which in turn improved drachma liquidity pulling money rates lower.
